description: This is the main entry point of a Flutter application for a grocery manager frontend. It defines the app's structure, including the main app widget and a stateful home page with a loading indicator.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: The root widget of the Flutter application, setting general theme and the home page.

classes.name: MyHomePage
classes.description: A stateful widget representing the main screen with a title, displaying a loading message and indicator.

classes.name: _MyHomePageState
classes.description: The state class managing the UI of MyHomePage, building a scaffold with an app bar and centered content.

methods.name: main
methods.description: The entry point of the application, which runs the root widget.

methods.name: build
methods.description: A method overridden in MyApp and _MyHomePageState to build the widget tree for each widget.
